newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-DYNAMO MOSCOW REACH RUSSIAN CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DYNAMO MOSCOW REACH RUSSIAN CUP FINAL.

text.p: Defender Yuri Kovtun fired Dynamo Moscow to a 1-0 win over Zenit St Petersburg in a Russian Cup semifinal on Tuesday.
The Russia international was on target from a corner in the 17th minute.
Vladimir Lebed had a great chance to level late in the game but his point blank header was saved by Dynamo goalkeeper Andrei Smetanin.
Dynamo will meet the winner of Wednesday's clash between Lokomotiv Moscow and Krylya Sovietov Samara in the final on June 11.
